articles.title: China’s Copper Squeeze Deepens as Buyers Scramble for Spot Metal
articles.excerpt:
Copper buyers in China are scrambling for physical metal, with spot premiums soaring as supplies tighten sharply in the world’s biggest consumer.

The premium for spot copper in Shanghai jumped to 1,900 yuan a ton over futures on Wednesday, the highest since 2021, according to data from Shanghai Metals Market. The surge is the latest sign that immediately available cathode is becoming increasingly scarce as production curbs by Chinese smelters tighten supplies.

“The persistent shortage is due to production cuts at domestic smelters and limited supplies from overseas such as Africa and Russia,” said Zhou Xiaoou, analyst at Zijin Tianfeng Futures Co. “Fabricators are buying hand to mouth.”
